title: Teacher of Science
description:
About HEART Academies Trust

HEART Academies Trust formed in 2017 and currently consists of one secondary school, Bedford Academy and five partner primary schools, Cauldwell School, Goldington Green Academy, Shackleton Primary, Shortstown Primary and Wilstead Primary.

We are a non-profit making charitable company sponsored by the Harpur Trust, one of the largest charities in the UK. With a proven track-record in education through their ownership and management of four Harpur Trust private schools in Bedford and as a sponsor of Bedford Academy since its creation in 2010, they are the perfect partner to support HEART Academies Trust as we grow.

HEART Academies Trust supports continuity of education within the community. Adopting a ‘stronger together’ approach and a commitment to positive collaboration enables each academy within the Trust to celebrate what they already do well whilst providing opportunities to ensure continued development and improvement across all academies within the Trust.

What We Offer

As part of HEART Academies Trust, staff are valued and supported, allowing them to contribute fully to the wider school community. Our commitment to staff development and wellbeing is paramount.

  • Paid wellbeing day per year.
  • CPD pathways, career progression, secondment and shadowing opportunities.
  • £200 Refer a friend scheme, tech scheme and cycle to work scheme.
  • Comprehensive employee assist programme.
  • Generous pension and a competitive salary.
  • Free gym, shower and parking facilities.
  • Free tea, coffee, breakfast and eye tests.
  • An exceptional ECT induction programme and support.
  • An open and collaborative working environment with an inclusive workplace
  • Regular training and development programmes and celebration of staff success.
  • An excellent in-house catering provision.
  • A commitment to environmental sustainability.

Main Duties Include

  • Ensure consistent application of the Academy’s chosen approach to assessment for Science groups, tracking student progress and securing understanding in other staff of their accountability for every individual’s progress.
  • Monitor provision across their Science classes, informing the Director of Achievement of areas of development, contributing to Team improvement plan for Science.
  • Demonstrate how effective provision for Science can enhance student learning and outcomes.
  • Research and develop new ideas, resources, units of work to disseminate within the learning village, looking for transferability across subjects. Produce high quality lesson plans and other exemplars as required.
  • Lead the promotion and development of students’ character through Science
  • Use data to inform learning and teaching within their area as appropriate, ensuring that lessons are well differentiated, providing for all individual students’ needs.

Who You Are

  • A person with high expectations, enthusiasm and the ability to positively impact on the learning, skills and experiences of our students
  • Degree, QTS (or working towards), relevant professional development
  • Successful secondary teaching experience in at least 2 of the key stages
  • Knowledge and understanding of Science, particularly GCSE skills, KS 3 expectations and the new KS2 national curriculum
  • Knowledge and understanding of how to rapidly impact on students’ numeracy skills
  • Significant personal impact on the outcomes for students, including their numeracy skills
  • Successful experience of teaching the full range of ability students, including students with additional needs such as SEN and EAL
  • Ability to be a consistently outstanding teacher, never less than good
  • Willingness and ability to accept accountability for student outcomes
  • Willingness to learn

We are unable to offer Visa Sponsorship.

Please call with any questions or reach out if you'd like to arrange a visit prior to interviews!

title: Backend Engineer III
description:
We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London or UK Remote | Engineer III

Compensation: £85,000 - £110,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology

About our Engineering Teams:

We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.

These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.

How we work

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays ️

Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency ✨

If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.

Work the way that works for you with Monzo!

You should apply if:

  • you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product
  • you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day
  • you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions
  • you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity
  • you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software
  • you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).
  • you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing

We're on the look out for L40 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework you will be interviewed across the whole framework, so if you're not sure what level you're aiming for chat to your recruiter!

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll be working on:

We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below:

  • Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here)
  • Cassandra for most persistent data storage
  • Kafka for our asynchronous message queue
  • Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services
  • Envoy Proxy for RPC
  • AWS for most of our production infrastructure and GCP for most of our data infrastructure
  • React for our public web apps and internal tools
  • We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties

The Interview Process:

Our interview process involves three main stages:

  1. Initial Call
  2. Take home task or pair coding exercise
  3. Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview

Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.

One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see here.

What’s in it for you:

£85,000 - £110,000 base salary + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK

✅ We can sponsor visas.

This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

We're usually always hiring for Backend Engineers, so there's no closing date for this job.

#LI-Remote

#LI-ZM1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage

title: Teacher of Design and Technology
description:
Job Title: Teacher of Design and Technology 

Actual Annual Salary: £17,955 - £27,845 (M1 - UPS3 based on 0.6 FTE)  

Full Time Equivalent Salary: £34,069 - £52,835 (M1 – UPS3) 

Contract Type: Permanent 

Hours: Part-time, 19.5 hours per week, 0.6 FTE 

Additional role info: Working Pattern - Mon, Weds, Thurs 

 

Provisional Start Date: 01 January 2027 (Subject to completion of pre-employment checks) 

Your opportunity to deliver outstanding Design and Technology lessons and inspire the next generation of designers, engineers and problem-solvers 

We are seeking a passionate and dynamic Teacher of Design and Technology to join Broadoak Academy from January 2027. You will play a key role in delivering a broad and engaging DT curriculum that fosters creativity, develops technical skills, and ignites a love of innovation in our students. 

At Broadoak Academy, you will join an established and collaborative Design and Technology team, supported by dedicated technicians who assist with lesson delivery and preparation. Our well-equipped facilities include specialist workshops, kitchens, and textiles classrooms, all resourced with modern equipment to enhance both your teaching and students’ learning experiences. 

As a teacher within CLF, you will set high expectations that inspire and challenge pupils, create a safe and stimulating learning environment, and support all students to make strong progress regardless of their starting points. You will contribute to the design and delivery of an ambitious curriculum, helping students to build practical skills, resilience, and confidence both within and beyond the classroom. 

We are looking for an inspirational teacher who is committed to delivering excellent educational experiences. You will have the opportunity to use your talents to play a key role in championing the success and life chances of all children across our trust. Through our commitment to high standards, a joy-filled and contemporary curriculum, and excellent teaching, we aim to create greater opportunities for lifelong success as our pupils grow into confident young adults. 

About you: 

You will be: 

  • a qualified teacher or hold an equivalent teaching qualification with strong subject knowledge in Design and Technology 
  • able to deliver a high-quality Design and Technology curriculum and teach engaging, well-structured lessons that promote creativity, independence and a love of learning 
  • able to plan sequences of learning that build on prior knowledge and enable all pupils to make good progress, using effective assessment to inform teaching 
  • able to differentiate effectively to meet the needs of all learners, including those from key identified groups such as pupil premium, looked after children, SEND and high attaining students 
  • committed to creating a safe and stimulating learning environment where high expectations of behaviour and mutual respect underpin strong relationships 
  • a strong communicator with the ability to build positive relationships with students, staff and parents, and contribute positively to the wider life of the academy 
  • proactive in developing your own teaching practice, reflective in your approach and committed to continuous professional development 
  • committed to equality, diversity and inclusion, championing the success and life chances of all children 
  • willing to contribute to enrichment opportunities beyond the classroom, enhancing students’ experiences and engagement with Design and Technology 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application. 

About Broadoak Academy: 

Broadoak Academy is an ever-growing secondary school located in Weston-super-Mare and is quickly becoming the school of choice for parents in the town. We are very proud to be an Ofsted-rated ‘Good’ school. We have a strong sense of belonging and community, and as such, we work together to offer students a well-balanced, happy and successful education. Our community is assured of Broadoak’s pivotal role in their children’s education, wellbeing and futures. 

Why CLF? 

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion.  

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered. 

What we can offer you: 

  • Access to the Teachers’ Pension Scheme. 
  • Comprehensive induction and ongoing support for career development and wellbeing.  
  • Sector-leading professional development entitlement and opportunities. 
  • Collaboration with colleagues across the trust through subject communities and specialist networks. 
  • Shared CLF curriculum, written and curated by trust experts, reducing individual teacher workload.   
  • Career enhancing and progression opportunities within the trust and through the CLF Institute. 
  • A collaborative culture which supports workload. 
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme. 
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs. 
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay. 
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking and many more! 

Recruitment timeline: 

• Closing Date: 23 October 2026 @11.59pm  

• Shortlisting: 24 October 2026 

• Interviews: 03 November 2026 

We welcome visits from potential candidates. If you would like to arrange a school visit prior to the closing date, please contact the academy/site directly to arrange a suitable appointment. 

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form.  

Skilled Worker sponsorship: This role may be eligible for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship, subject to the candidate meeting the applicable Home Office eligibility and salary requirements. Full-time and 0.8 FTE positions will generally meet the required salary threshold; for other part-time working arrangements, eligibility will depend on the salary applicable to the role and the candidate's working pattern. To help us assess whether sponsorship may be available, we encourage candidates who require sponsorship to provide their current salary information when completing the application form. 

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out.    

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are dedicated to equity and inclusion and commit to interviewing applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria. We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or require any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process please let us know how we can assist.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.
We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will:

  • Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination).

  • Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance.

  • Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.

  • Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.

  • Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.

  • Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.

  • Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.

  • Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.

  • Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more!

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure.

  • A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.

  • Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.

  • Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.

  • Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.

  • Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).

  • AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.

  • Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.

  • The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers.

  • You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements.

  • You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy.

  • You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team.

  • You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

  • Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised.

  • Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it.

  • Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis.

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options.

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Core skills test: An async AI-assisted programming test to assess your coding fundamentals.

  3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat deep diving into your experience.

  4. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute system design interview focusing on your architecture, infrastructure and problem-solving skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • This role focuses heavily on building services for internal / external users consumption. It is absolutely critical to have extensive API design and development experience, expertise in OLAP systems and to be able to work in Kotlin. Ensure your CV reflects clearly of the actual experience you have across those areas.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications

title: Staff Engineer - Business Spend
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.
We will not review any applications before the closing window so please don't rush to apply and use the time to submit a high quality application.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Business Spend segment at Pleo. In this role, you'll help us build invoices, purchase orders, supplier invoices, cards for subscriptions and be part of Business Spend as we scale procurement to pay services. If you're excited about systems with real history and are passionate about building services that handle what a company spends to run itself, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Engineering Manager in Business Spend and work closely with teams in accounting systems and card infrastructure. Our team of 10 is highly collaborative and dedicated to invoices and vendors. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across product, design and compliance to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Staff Engineer, you will:

  • Partner with the Engineering Manager to own and be accountable for the whole architecture of Business Spend.

  • Own significant parts of our supplier data migration, moving supplier and bank account logic out of a legacy service into a dedicated one, per customer and without downtime.

  • Improve the reliability of our invoice payment flows, where roughly 2.5% of payments currently fail and every failure is a customer who can't pay a supplier.

  • Turn our new vendor data model into working software, so that a supplier means the same thing across cards, invoices, and accounting.

  • Help the 3 teams make consistent technical decisions, through design documents, code review, and the architecture forum, without being anyone's manager.

  • Raise the people around you, through pairing, review, and writing things down clearly enough that someone in another time zone can act on them.

To put things into context, here's what's on our roadmap right now: extracting supplier management out of our legacy invoice service, meeting the ISO 20022 structured address requirements for outbound payments, and rebuilding how we model suppliers and vendors across the whole of Business Spend.

On the technical side, you can expect to work with the following stack: AWS, Github actions, Kotlin on the JVM, Kafka, Spring Boot, Gradle, Kubernetes, and Grafana for metrics, logs, and traces. Our frontend is TypeScript and React.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong verbal communication. You can hold a room of engineers who don't share a first language and leave everyone clear on what was decided.

  • Experience as the technical lead for a team spread across several countries and time zones. You adapt how you communicate rather than expecting everyone to adapt to you, and you're as effective in writing and async as you are live.

  • Deep backend engineering experience in a modern statically typed language such as Java, Kotlin or TypeScript, on systems running in production at scale.

  • A track record of shipping inside a legacy system that was being taken apart. Not just designing the target state, but doing the migration.

  • The ability to change technical direction across teams you don't own, with specific examples of when you've done it.

  • Writing that other people can act on. Design documents, decision records, migration plans that work without you in the room.

  • A background in payments, fintech, accounts payable, ERP or B2B SaaS.

  • Experience with event-driven systems and Kafka, and a habit of building observability into what you ship.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want to work on a genuinely unsolved problem. How a company models its suppliers across cards, invoices, and accounting is the hardest open question in our product, and we're answering it this year.

  • You want your work to be visible. The team is small enough that one person changes the outcome, and you'll see the effect on customers within weeks.

  • You like being the person others come to, and you'd rather earn that through the work than be handed it in a job title.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You want a green field project. You'll spend a real share of your time in code you didn't write, with constraints you didn't choose.

  • You want to design the target state and hand it over. Here you design it and then you build it.

  • You need formal authority to get things moving. You'll need to rely on technical influence and earn trust across 3 teams.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

  • Take ownership of a major workstream in the supplier migration and carry it to production.

  • Work with the Accounts Payable team to improve payment reliability and the observability behind it.

  • Build the relationships across all 3 teams that make cross-team technical work possible, and grow into a larger share of the architecture direction for Business Spend.

We're committed to helping you develop your career. For this role, that means a growing share of technical direction across the segment, and a clear conversation about what the next level looks like and what it takes to get there. We'd rather have that conversation early than have you find the answer somewhere else.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute experience-based conversation to deep dive into technical leadership experience, achievements and complexity you’ve been used to.

  3. Core skills test: A 75-minute system-design interview with two of our engineers to deep dive into your architecture and problem solving skills.

  4. Pleo challenge: A 60-minute presentation interview focusing on discussing one of your previous achievements.

  5. Final interview: A 45-minute leadership interview assessing your behavioural skills and values.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Staff Engineer, we received a total of 1258 applications but only 8 were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • The Staff seniority level at Pleo requires to have extensive experience operating as a technical lead / owner of initiatives that have cross team / domain impact in SaaS organisations of 500+ people. We’re also looking for someone with significant experience architecting services across multiple domains (e.g. invoicing, subscription cards etc.) and with the ability to decouple complex legacy systems through an effective long-term delivery plan. If you do not have this experience, please do not apply. If you do have this experience, please ensure your CV truly reflects it.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep thi

Through your subject expertise, you will deliver a high-quality Mathematics curriculum that develops students’ confidence, numerical fluency and problem-solving skills, while helping them understand the relevance of Maths in the wider world. 


Our commitment to high standards, an ambitious curriculum and excellent teaching empowers young people to become capable, curious and mathematically literate learners, equipped with the skills they need for future study, employment and life beyond school. 

 

About you 

You will be:

title: Lead Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote US

 Company Description

 At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.

 We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care.

 We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer programs spanning the full care continuum , including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.

 For almost two decades, Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.

 Brief Overview

 This role owns Amwell's marketing web estate and how discoverable it is, across four properties: SilverCloud, business.amwell.com, patients.amwell.com, and LiveHealthOnline. Accountability covers performance and conversion on those properties, the compliance posture of what runs on them, and discoverability as search behavior shifts toward AI-generated answers.

 The role directs work rather than performing all of it. Engineering owns development capacity and Design owns visual execution; this role defines, sequences, and holds the quality of the work both produce for the web estate. Page content and messaging remain with the pillar that owns each page, so this role owns the platform and its performance rather than what the pages say.

 Core Responsibilities

 What the role owns:

 • The four web properties — performance, conversion, and delivery

 • Web compliance and governance, including cookie consent and tracking governance

 • GEO and AI-answer discoverability across the properties, alongside conventional search performance

 • Definition and sequencing of website build and development work delivered by Engineering

 • Coordination with the separate Design team on visual work for the estate

 • The web roadmap and the case for what it returns

 How success is measured:

 • Conversion performance across the four properties, and measured improvement in GEO and AI-answer discoverability (primary measurable output)

 • Web property performance, including speed and core experience measures

 • Tracking-compliance coverage across the estate

 • Delivery of the web roadmap against plan

 • Contribution of web to demand and engagement funnels

 What the role does not own:

 Scope boundaries are explicit, so accountability is single-owned and hand-offs are clean.

 • Page content and messaging — each pillar owns what its own pages say

 • Product application surfaces — Product

 • Engineering development capacity itself — Engineering owns the resource; this role directs the work

 • Visual design execution — the separate Design team

 • Off-site authority and earned citations — Brand and Corporate Marketing with the external agency

 • Paid media and demand strategy — Demand Generation Manager

 Qualifications

 • 7+ years in web, digital marketing, or growth, with direct ownership of a web estate

 • A track record of moving a conversion measure on owned properties, not only of shipping site work

 • Technical SEO depth, and demonstrated engagement with GEO and AI-answer discoverability

 • Experience directing engineering delivery without owning the engineering resource

 • Web compliance and tracking governance experience, including consent management

 • Analytics fluency sufficient to defend what the web numbers claim

 • The ability to hold a roadmap across competing stakeholder demands from multiple pillars

 Preferred

 • Healthcare or other regulated-industry web experience, including accessibility obligations

 • Multi-property or multi-brand estate management

 • CMS migration or replatforming experience

 • Experience establishing GEO measurement where no baseline existed

 Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell.

 Driven by our mission and values, we foster a workplace where Delivering Awesome, being Customer First and operating as One Team aren’t just aspirations – they are how we work, every day.

 Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to empower their growth and development not only as Amwellians but as individuals, through generous total rewards packages, a virtual-first work environment, work-life flexibility, including Summer Fridays and designated Mental Health Days, as well as opportunities to stretch and learn – to name a few. It’s our people who truly differentiate us. Ask anyone and they’ll tell you – you’ll never work with more passionate, more driven and more caring team members.

 We champion a culture of respect and inclusion, accountability and integrity, innovation and collaboration. At Amwell, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career—improving healthcare for millions, growing alongside incredible teammates, and being valued for who you are.

 Benefits

• Flexible Personal Time Off (Vacation time)

• 401K match

• Competitive healthcare, dental and vision insurance plans

• Paid Parental Leave (Maternity and Paternity leave)

• Employee Stock Purchase Program

• Free access to Amwell’s Telehealth Services, SilverCloud and The Clinic by Cleveland Clinic’s second opinion program

• Free Subscription to the Calm App

• Tuition Assistance Program

• Pet Insurance

 Salaried, Exempt Roles

 The typical base salary range for this position is $121,950 - $149,050. The actual salary offer will ultimately depend on multiple factors including, but not limited to, knowledge, skills, relevant education, experience, complexity or specialization of talent, and other objective factors. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and employee performance. Long-term incentive and short-term variable compensation may be offered as part of the compensation package dependent on the role. Some roles may be commission based, in which case the total compensation will be based on a commission, and the above range may not be an accurate representation of total compensation.

 Further, the above range is subject to change based on market demands and operational needs and does not constitute a promise of a particular wage or a guarantee of employment. Your recruiter can share more during the hiring process about the specific salary range based on the above factors listed.

 Fraud Prevention Notice

 As part of Amwell's commitment to maintaining a secure and trusted hiring process, Amwell uses fraud detection capabilities within its hiring platform to help identify potentially suspicious, fraudulent, or unauthorized activity during the recruitment process.

 These tools are designed to help protect candidates, Amwell, and the integrity of the hiring process by identifying indicators that may be associated with impersonation, account misuse, or other forms of recruiting fraud. Information generated through fraud detection is reviewed by authorized personnel and is not used as the sole basis for hiring decisions.

 Personal information collected or processed in connection with fraud detection will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws and Amwell's Applicant Privacy Notice.

 Identity Verification Notice

 As part of Amwell's commitment to maintaining a secure and trusted hiring process, candidates for this role are required to complete an identity verification step through Greenhouse Identity Verification powered by CLEAR during the interview process.

 Identity verification is used solely to confirm a candidate's identity and help prevent fraud and impersonation within the hiring process. It is not a background check and does not independently determine hiring decisions.

 Because this role has been designated as requiring identity verification, completion of the verification process is a condition of continuing in the recruitment process. Candidates who do not complete the identity verification process will not be eligible to advance to subsequent stages of consideration for this role.

 Personal information collected as part of the identity verification process will be handled in accordance with applicable privacy laws and Amwell's Applicant Privacy Notice.

 Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. Stripe is investing in building out its Fraud & Risk Product Sales team and as an Account Executive you will be a critical part of the team driving the growth of this product.

 What you’ll do

 As an Account Executive, Product focusing on Fraud & Risk products, you will use your sales and product expertise to help drive product market fit & growth of Stripe’s fraud fighting products and solutions. You will collaborate with product, engineering and marketing teams to develop deep product and industry knowledge and drive strategic deals. You will be instrumental in leading in depth product discussions with existing and prospect users globally – and building and executing against our go to market strategy.

 You are an adept salesperson, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including CEOs, CTOs, and Chief Risk Officers. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding. You’re as comfortable working with clients as with internal stakeholders (including executives). You’re excited to become an expert and to share your knowledge. You’re an organized self-starter, an excellent communicator who is highly analytical and has a track record for improving the processes and organizations around you.

 Brief Overview

 This role produces member-facing content across Amwell's service lines and is accountable for how that content performs once it reaches members. Content is a shared capability across the Engagement pillar: the account owners brief and approve, and this role produces at the volume and quality the book requires.

 The role covers content strategy across service lines, the Engagement Hub content library, and the production of case studies and enablement assets that the account owners design. Content engagement is a shared measure with the execution side, which owns timing and deliverability

 How success is measured:

 • Content engagement across member-facing email and hub content, as the content contribution to open and click performance (primary measurable output)

 • Content throughput and turnaround against briefs

 • Brand-voice and quality consistency across the library

 • Coverage of the service lines against the content plan

 What the role does not own:

 Scope boundaries are explicit so accountability is single-owned and hand-offs are clean.

 • Campaign strategy or the customer relationship — the account owners

 • The CMS platform itself, its branding rules, templates, and access — Manager, Campaign Production and Platform

 • Campaign build, QA, and send — the campaign production team

 • Timing and deliverability of sends, which share the engagement measure

 • Foundational B2B content such as case studies, playbooks, and whitepapers — Commercialization

 • PHI governance standards, which are set by Compliance

 Qualifications

 Required

 • 5+ years producing consumer, member, or patient-facing content at volume

 • Demonstrated ability to move a content engagement measure, not only to ship content on time

 • Experience writing within regulated or clinically sensitive constraints, and the judgment to know when to route something to Compliance or Legal

 • Experience directing freelance, agency, or contractor capacity against a brief

 • Working fluency with AI-assisted drafting, and the editorial judgment to hold quality across it

 • Comfort operating as shared capacity across competing internal demands

 Preferred

 • Healthcare, health plan, or behavioral health content experience

 • Knak, Braze, or comparable content and email production platforms

 • Accessibility standards for member communications

 • Experience building or restructuring a content library

 Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell.

title: Analyst
description:
Headquarters: Remote US

 At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 About the Risk & Analytics Team

 The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

 Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

 We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

 One Role, Multiple Teams

 We are hiring multiple Analyst I roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

 If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

 Potential team placements include:

• Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.

• Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.

• Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.

• Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, machine learning models, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.

• Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.

• International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.

 About the Role

 As an Analyst I in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Analyst I roles share a common foundation: using data to understand business performance, identify opportunities, and help Affirm make better decisions.

 You will learn the fundamentals of consumer lending while executing scoped analytical work under the guidance of senior analysts and managers. You will leverage SQL, Python, and modern analytical tools to help optimize business strategies, monitor performance, and turn complex data into actionable insights.

 You are a thoughtful, driven individual eager to build a strong technical foundation, learn how to navigate exogenous market changes, and integrate modern AI tooling to solve hard problems efficiently.

 What You Will Do

• Derive Insights & Support Strategy: Leverage data analytics to uncover insights that help optimize product, risk, or growth strategies across geographies.

• Monitor Portfolio Health: Assist in tracking performance metrics, user behavior, and macroeconomic trends that impact business outcomes, flagging risks and anomalies to senior team members.

• Technical Execution: Write clean, working SQL and Python to build scalable reporting and partner with Engineering to support the deployment of machine learning and risk models.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance to understand evolving consumer lending regulations and market requirements, assisting in translating them into foundational data models and operational policies.

• Drive Launch Alignment: Support cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with our operational capabilities and risk appetite.

• AI Fluency & Efficiency: Integrate AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and copilots into your daily workflows to accelerate data mining and routine tasks, while carefully verifying outputs.

 What We Look For

• 1–3 years of experience in an analytically driven role. Relevant internships or prior experience in consumer lending, fintech, or the broader financial services industry are highly valued.

• Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

• Solid working knowledge of SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.

• Familiarity with data mining, data visualization, and foundational statistical modeling.

• Basic understanding of, or deep curiosity about, consumer lending regulations, fair lending principles, and how machine learning techniques apply to real-world business problems.

• Exceptional communication skills, humility, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional peers.

 Pay Grade - I
Equity Grade - 5

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $101,000 - $151,000

Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

 Benefits designed for you
 Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

 Role

title: Director, Global Campaigns
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Director of Global Campaigns.

About the job

As the head of the Twilio Global Campaign team, you are responsible for owning, developing and executing the major campaigns that drive awareness and opportunities for Twilio. This role is highly cross functional, working closely with both internal marketing partners across regions, sales, product, and company leadership to design end-to-end campaigns that deliver on business objectives. You possess a proven track record of leading multi-channel global campaigns with success, collaborating with stakeholders, and finding opportunities to strategically uplevel Twilio’s campaign engine.

The ideal candidate has an advanced understanding of how campaigns resonate with a global audience, not just one country. You are skilled in understanding the modern AI-driven buyer journey at each stage of the funnel, have the ability to translate messaging frameworks into effective campaigns, and thrives in a collaborative environment. You recognize the value of running an integrated campaign motion, and have the ability to think both strategically and execute at an operational level with ease. Your performance will be measured by your ability to execute and achieve measurable results including building brand awareness, developing a system of content and assets that is valuable to all regions, and building campaigns that accelerate growth velocity.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Set a strategic vision for global campaign structure, operations, and execution for our top 5 campaign motions. We are looking for someone who is very strategic in terms of knowing the audience, how to create content that resonates, tactics to reach that audience, and ideas that are visionary and tactical.
  • Be accountable to company leadership on the effectiveness of all global campaigns and programs
  • Strong project management skills and ability to use data to guide decision-making and resource allocation. Design and execute strategic end-to-end campaigns that both engage and convert prospective buyers with a focus on specific buyer and vertical segments
  • Partner with product marketing, content strategists, brand strategists, creative designers and other regional campaign teams to create campaign themes and messaging that translate into impactful marketing campaigns. Act as the central point of contact to direct all campaign work across teams to ensure timely results
  • Build strong relationships with key cross functional stakeholders across multiple organizations to ensure campaign enablement and engagement
  • A global systems approach. Develop scalable, repeatable campaign playbooks that can be scaled quickly with a large variety of content that works in all regions
  • Track program results, measure program success and report metrics to customer success, sales and marketing stakeholders and executives. Then analyze campaign performance, surface insights and provide recommendations for optimizing results
  • AI-Driven Enablement: We want you to infuse AI frameworks into all aspects of the campaign model. Ideally you would disrupt the norms and evolve the team and programs to be progressive. And equip teams across the organization with the tools, guidelines, and frameworks to create high-quality content at scale, including standards, reusable templates, and AI-assisted workflows that improve consistency, speed, and quality.
  • Budget Management: Manage and allocate budget for campaign production resources across all campaign and persona needs, including original content, video production, localization, and agencies to ensure efficient and high-quality execution and return on investment
  • Global team leadership: Manage a team with a global remit that spans all regions from the US to Europe to Asia, while working with company and brand leadership to execute all top-of-funnel campaigns.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Management experience: ability to inspire a team of strategists and show a vision of what is possible and where our teams should focus efforts
  • Deep understanding of marketing funnel tactics and metrics by stage, PLG model and funnel
  • Understanding of enterprise buying cycles, sales processes and stakeholders, especially in B2B tech
  • Self-starter who excels in a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative high-growth environment
  • Ability to manage multiple work streams and has presence with the team and leadership
  • Strategic thinker with strong attention to detail
  • 8+ years working as a campagin strategist in B2B or tech
  • Proven experience building and delivering on integrated programs and managing all tools, processes, and assets
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to drive alignment, set expectations and drive to success
  • Works well with cross-functional teams and executives, to ensure consistent content is delivered across the company
  • A champion for fostering a culture of trust through feedback, communication, and transparency

Desired:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organization.
  • Familiarity with localization tactics to ensure our content is accessible and inclusive across multiple countries.
  • Experience with primary research strategies and types of content creation
  • Strategic ability to see opportunities across campaigns and programs where new types of content and programs will thrive.
  • Experience building world-class brands through premium content
  • Experience with a variety of AI, design, analytics, and video tools. Proficiency in digital marketing tools and platforms such as Tableau, Salesforce, AEM, Google Analytics, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Canva

Location

This role will be remote based in Ireland or the UK

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. title: Deal Desk Analyst
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Deal Desk team partners closely with our Sales organisation to drive market wins and achieve our revenue targets. As the Deal Desk Analyst supporting EMEA Mid-Market, you'll drive commercial outcomes for the region, applying deal economics and policy judgment to help Sales structure terms that win deals and protect Samsara's revenue. You'll work closely with Sales, Legal, and Finance leadership across the region, and you'll be the person Sales calls when a deal needs a fast, well-reasoned answer.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You bring clarity to high-stakes conversations: You're comfortable telling a seller no and keeping them on your side — and just as ready to get on a live customer call when a deal needs a clear, confident voice in the room.
  • You live at the intersection of sales and finance: You can look at a discount, a payment schedule and know exactly what it means for Samsara's revenue — and you want to be the one making that call, deal by deal.

In this role, you will:

  • Own deal economics for the EMEA Mid-Market portfolio and know when a deal sits within your approval authority versus when it needs to escalate
  • Sign off on certain non-standard terms within your own financial parameters, backed by your own authority rather than a case-by-case Legal review
  • Manage the EMEA Mid-Market deal desk end-to-end — hold Sales to policy on discount and payment terms, help shape the SLAs and triage rules that keep a high-volume pipeline moving using AI tools to drive efficiency
  • Partner with Sales to solve for non-standard requests — while maintaining a partnership mindset
  • Protect quarter-end metrics anchoring deals on annual terms early and applying your team's escalation framework consistently
  • Own final approval for your segment, and coach Sales on the thresholds so they flag you before a deal needs you
  • Partner with Legal, Sales and Customers directly when a deal needs Deal Desk's voice in the room
  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement to keep Sales current on policies and thresholds — 1:1s, group sessions, refreshers, and onboarding for new starters
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Experience in a comparable role within Deal Desk
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate deal economics against company policy
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (formulas, modelling) and experience with CRM systems (i.e., Salesforce) and quoting tools
  • Proven experience owning a large, high-volume book independently with minimal oversight, and knowing when a deal needs to be escalated
  • Experience operating in a high-volume queue with frequent, direct pushback from Sales, while maintaining a partnership mindset
  • Proficient with AI tools (e.g., internal deal-desk AI assistants, CRM copilots) for research, drafting, and speedy deal reviews
  • Strong communication skills, resilience, and a problem-solving mindset — comfortable being the voice of finance on a live Sales or customer call, and steady under a high volume of pushback
  • This is a remote first position open to candidates based in the United Kingdom with travel to our London office (1 Alie St, London E1 8DE) as needed. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role

An ideal candidate also:

  • Has direct, first-hand experience defending a commercial position live with a customer or seller, not just reviewing tickets
  • Has experience operating in a small, fast-paced, high-ownership environment, and is comfortable being the sole owner of a function end-to-end
  • Is self-motivated, intellectually curious, and commercially minded
  • Builds real partnerships across Sales, Legal, Sales Ops, Credit/Order Management
  • Has an appetite for enablement — comfortable training and upskilling a Sales team on policy and deal structuring, not just gatekeeping it
  • Is comfortable with financial modelling in spreadsheets/CPQ (cash-flow payback, gross margin, blended discount, payment-term impact) and picks up new systems quickly
  • Proactively identifies and helps resolve internal process or systems friction (e.g., issues with GTM Systems tooling), partnering with the Implementation team to fix it

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. Belonging at Samsara
