description:
Who are we looking for?

We are looking to recruit a Head of Progress who can provide strong leadership and pastoral support to our students. We are committed to providing excellent pastoral support and inclusion to our students and wish to appoint a well-qualified and talented Head of Progress (Head of Year) to provide a stimulating and dynamic environment for our students. You will lead and manage the pastoral needs of your year group developing effective systems and strategies to ensure that all students in the year group are supported fulfil their educational potential. You will be a teacher of English, Geography or Business Studies.

About Furze Platt

Furze Platt is a highly successful and inclusive mixed comprehensive school serving the children of Maidenhead. At Furze Platt, 1500 students of all abilities develop the skills and qualities to enable them to excel in the future. We are an ambitious, high-achieving and fully inclusive school in which our students are challenged and supported to achieve excellence. We are well placed for access, with good transport links to and from London and surrounding counties. Our school is very well resourced and equipped with many new facilities benefiting students and staff. These include a state-of-the-art theatre, gym, fitness suite and a new three-storey teaching block incorporating science laboratories and classrooms. We have rolled out our Laptops for Learning initiative to ensure all students are equipped with a laptop.

We want our students to enjoy the time they spend with us by providing an education which is broad, stimulating and rewarding. We encourage all our staff to offer enrichment opportunities with over 50 clubs and societies being offered each term. We are proud of this range of extra-curricular opportunities including Duke of Edinburgh, ski and theatre trips, and historical knowledge and many others.

Why join Furze Platt?

We want our staff to feel valued, supported and part of our school community. As part of the Furze Platt team, you will benefit from:

    • A friendly and supportive working environment
    • A strong commitment to staff physical and mental wellbeing
    • Discounted membership of our fully equipped, well-maintained on-site gym
    • Career opportunities allowing you to grow professionally within Furze Platt
    • Access to a wellbeing benefit offering video and phone GP consultations, counselling support, physiotherapy and much more - all designed to help support your health and wellbeing
    • Opportunities to get involved in our wider staff community, including social events, after school sports and our Furze Platt fantasy football league
    • Recognition of long service and a culture that values staff contribution

    We offer a friendly and harmonious campus atmosphere, with a Senior Leadership Team who genuinely want to see you succeed and develop. Furze Platt is the lead school for Teach Maidenhead, a teacher training partnership which offers School Direct teacher training giving staff the opportunity to develop their mentoring skills. ECTs are allocated a mentor, a reduced timetable and the opportunity to attend training sessions run by specialists from within the school.

    We have free parking on site, and we also ensure that freshly brewed coffee is ready for you during break-time with edible treats to help you through the week!

    Make a difference with us

    If you are enthusiastic about supporting young people, and would like to be part of a welcoming and ambitious school community, we would love to hear from you.

    Furze Platt Senior School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people, and we expect all staff to share this commitment. This post is subject to an enhanced disclosure via the Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS).

    We reserve the right to close the vacancy early should the right candidate be appointed, so early applications are encouraged.

    Interested applicants are welcome to talk to Mrs Amanda Cook, Head of Employee Relations Amanda.cook@furzeplatt.net about this post, or to visit the school.

location: Bishop's Stortford, East of England, GB
description:
Subject Leader of Physical Education

School: St Mary's Catholic School, CM23 2NQ

Salary: MPS/UPS + TLR2b (Outer Fringe) (£35,602 - £54,327 + £6,077) Full Time, Permanent

We seek applications from those of the Catholic faith, all faiths and of no faith but who are supportive of our Christian values and ethos.

About the Role

We are seeking to appoint an outstanding, ambitious and inspirational Subject Leader of Physical Education to lead our highly successful PE department and build upon its recent achievements. This is an exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic teacher and leader to shape the future direction of PE, sport and physical wellbeing across the whole school, including Sixth Form.

The successful candidate will join a thriving Catholic school community where students are well behaved, motivated and eager to participate both in lessons and in the extensive programme of extracurricular sport. The department enjoys a strong reputation for academic and sporting excellence and plays a central role in school life.

The Role

This is a full time permanent role. As Subject Leader of PE, you will provide strategic leadership for the department, ensuring that all students are inspired to achieve their full potential in both physical education and sport. You will:

Lead and manage a successful and dedicated PE team

Drive continued improvement in student achievement and progress across all key stages

Develop and enhance a broad, ambitious and engaging PE curriculum

Monitor and evaluate teaching, learning and assessment to secure excellent outcomes

Promote inclusion and participation for all students

Further develop the school's strong extracurricular and competitive sports programme

Foster a culture of excellence, enjoyment and lifelong participation in physical activity

About the Department

PE is a vibrant, high-performing and highly valued subject within the school. The department has enjoyed significant recent success, both in examination outcomes and competitive sport, and plays a central role in promoting the school's culture of aspiration, teamwork and excellence.

In recent years, students have achieved strong outcomes in GCSE and Post-16 PE courses, with consistently high levels of progress and engagement. The department has also celebrated success across a range of competitive sports, with teams regularly competing and achieving success at local, district and county level. Participation in extracurricular sport continues to flourish, with large numbers of students representing the school and contributing to its reputation for sporting excellence.

The PE department is committed to developing the whole child and provides a broad programme of opportunities including competitive sport, leadership development, officiating, coaching and enrichment activities. Students are encouraged to develop resilience, confidence, teamwork and leadership skills alongside their academic achievements.

We are looking for a leader who can build upon these recent successes, further strengthen examination outcomes and continue to grow participation and achievement across the school.

About Our School

Our school is founded on the values of Love, Respect and Flourish, which underpin every aspect of school life. We are proud to serve a diverse and inclusive community where each young person is known, valued and encouraged to develop their unique God-given talents.

Our students are one of our greatest strengths. They are respectful, ambitious and enthusiastic learners who respond positively to challenge and have a genuine pride in their school community. They actively engage in the wide range of sporting, cultural and enrichment opportunities available to them and demonstrate excellent attitudes both in lessons and beyond the classroom.

The school serves a diverse community and is proud of its inclusive ethos, where every student is encouraged to discover and develop their God-given talents. Sport is an important part of that journey, helping pupils to develop confidence, resilience, leadership and a lifelong commitment to health and wellbeing.

Sport and physical wellbeing are central to our vision for developing confident, resilient and successful young people. We recognise the important role PE plays in promoting health, character development, teamwork, leadership and resilience.

Working Within the Trust

As part of the St Francis of Assisi Catholic Academy Trust, our staff benefit from being part of a collaborative family of schools committed to delivering excellence in Catholic education.

The Trust offers:

Excellent professional development and leadership opportunities

A culture of collaboration and shared expertise across schools

Access to a wide network of specialist colleagues

Opportunities to contribute to Trust-wide sporting initiatives and curriculum development

A strong commitment to staff wellbeing and workload considerations

Supportive and ambitious leadership focused on helping staff flourish professionally

This role presents an exciting opportunity to influence PE provision not only within the school but also through collaboration across the wider Trust.

The Person

We are looking for a candidate who:

Is an outstanding teacher of PE with a proven track record of securing excellent outcomes

Has the vision and leadership skills to continue developing an already successful department

Demonstrates strong curriculum knowledge across Key Stages 3, 4 and Post-16

Can inspire students of all abilities to achieve success and develop a lifelong love of physical activity

Has high expectations of achievement, behaviour and participation

Is committed to contributing to the wider life of the school through extracurricular sport and enrichment

Fully supports the values and ethos of our Catholic school community

Applications are welcomed from practising Christians, those of other faiths and those of no faith who are supportive of the school's Christian ethos and values.

If you are passionate about excellence in PE, committed to developing young people and ready to lead a high-performing department within a supportive and ambitious Trust, we would be delighted to hear from you.

title: Speech and Language Therapist
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen to join our Trust’s established SEND team as a Speech & Language Therapist. Working three days per week during term time, you will play a vital role in supporting children with speech, language and communication needs across our family of primary schools. 

Working alongside our experienced SENDCos and supporting the Head of Children’s Services, we are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced therapist with a proven track record of delivering high-quality interventions for children with additional communication needs within a primary school setting. 

This is a rewarding opportunity to make a meaningful difference to pupils’ educational experiences and outcomes while working as part of a collaborative and supportive multidisciplinary team. 

Main Purpose of the Role 

To provide a high standard of speech and language therapy support, including assessment, intervention and advice for children, parents and staff. This will include contribution to the development of the Trust’s universal SLCN offer, support and training for staff in the delivery of whole school and group SALT programmes. Providing guidance for parents/carers is also part of the role. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Deliver an effective and responsive speech and language therapy service across the Trust 
  • Lead the delivery and training of whole-class and group SLCN interventions 
  • Provide advice regarding NHS SLCN referrals and support staff to deliver NHS programmes 
  • Manage a caseload of children with a range of communication needs if needed in addition to NHS input 
  • Assess pupils with speech, language and communication difficulties and analyse findings to determine the most appropriate interventions 
  • Plan, deliver and evaluate individual and group-based therapy programmes. 
  • Develop, implement and review personalised speech, language and communication programmes, providing accessible guidance and training for school staff and families where appropriate 
  • Use evidence-based practice to support clinical decision-making and maintain high standards of clinical governance and risk management 
  • Contribute to reviews, multi-agency meetings and wider SEND planning, promoting effective partnership working 
  • Liaise with a range of professionals, including educational staff, healthcare practitioners, therapists and other external agencies, to support positive outcomes for pupils 
  • Support transition planning and attend appointments or meetings where required 
  • Contribute positively to the wider work of the Trust and support colleagues as needed 

About You 

We are looking for a qualified and committed professional who has: 

Qualifications 

  • A recognised Degree in Speech and Language Therapy (or equivalent). 
  • Current registration with the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC). 
  • Membership of the Royal College of Speech and Language Therapists (RCSLT). 
  • A commitment to working within RCSLT clinical guidelines and HCPC professional standards. 

Experience and Skills 

  • Experience working as a Speech and Language Therapist, preferably in schools 
  • Experience supporting children and young people with social communication difficulties and additional communication needs 
  • Experience producing detailed and complex reports 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly to children, families and professionals 
  • The ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a wider team 
  • Experience in delivering CPD to individuals and groups would be beneficial 

The successful candidate will be required to travel between our schools and must be able to make their own way between our five Exeter schools, one Exmouth school and one Barnstaple school

What We Offer 

  • A salary of £35,611 to £39,305 FTE (pro rata for 8am-5pm, 3 days per week, 40 weeks per year). 
  • Local Government Pension Scheme. 
  • Access to modern IT equipment. 
  • Ongoing investment in professional development and CPD. 
  • Cycle to Work Scheme. 
  • Health Plan. 
  • Subsidised meals in our staff cafés. 
  • Free on-site parking. 

Apply Today

We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming the successful candidate to our Trust. 

Closing Date: 1st November 2026 

Interviews: Applications will be reviewed as they are received and interviews may be held before the closing date. Early applications are therefore encouraged. 

This post is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (Exceptions) Order 1975 (2013 and 2020).  This means that certain convictions and cautions are considered ‘protected’ and do not need to be disclosed to employers, and if they are disclosed, employers cannot take them into account.  Guidance about whether a conviction or caution should be disclosed can be found on the Ministry of Justice website.

An enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service check is required for all our posts. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expect all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. Please note online searches may be done as part of pre-recruitment checks

We look forward to receiving your application and hopefully meeting you as part of the recruitment process.

description:
Headquarters: Remote (USA - San Francisco, CA)

 PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

 ABOUT THE ROLE

 PagerDuty is seeking a Sr. Director, Field Enablement to join our diverse, customer-focused team! As Sr. Director of Field Enablement, you will lead a team of enablement professionals supporting our sales, customer success, and partnership organizations.

 You will build and scale our global enablement function to ensure our customer-facing teams are equipped to sell and support our diversifying product portfolio as we enter our next phase of growth. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the enablement strategy for a high-growth SaaS company and directly improve teams' capabilities and productivity worldwide. The ideal candidate is a strategic, seasoned enablement leader passionate about gathering customer feedback and competitive intelligence to develop programs that drive sales excellence and business results.

 ABOUT PAGERDUTY

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, execute, optimize, and assess enablement programs in partnership with sales and customer success leadership, determining priorities and success metrics with key stakeholders

• Gather and share insights from customers, competitors, and the market to enable the positioning of PagerDuty’s value proposition to the market

• Drive the creation of learning programs and events that align with overall sales and company strategy, enhancing team capabilities, productivity, and high-level selling skills

• Build and maintain an enablement delivery platform that provides scalable, measurable content and learning resources to sales, customer success, and partnership teams

• Collaborate with marketing and product marketing to develop highly effective and repeatable sales messaging, selling tools, and collateral that enable consistent execution

• Design and maintain an end-to-end sales onboarding program in collaboration with HR that certifies new hires on company strategy, product messaging, and sales processes

• Develop and lead the everboarding process for the sales team to ensure the continued development of required behaviors and skills to successfully operate a consumption driven business

• Build out and scale enablement support functions for Customer Success and Partnerships organizations

• Communicate the enablement strategy, roadmap, and KPIs to stakeholders across all global organizations

• Develop and maintain a library of sales enablement resources, including sales playbooks, battle cards, product collateral, content library, and competitive intelligence

• Drive adoption and utilization of sales enablement tools such as MindTickle and Highspot

• Partner with the sales systems team to drive adoption and utilization of sales tools such as Clari, Salesloft, Salesforce, and others

• Conduct regular assessments and audits of sales processes and identify areas for improvement and optimization.

• Set key metrics to assess the impact of sales enablement efforts on sales performance

• Stay up-to-date with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in sales enablement

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field. MBA is a plus

• 10+ years of sales enablement experience or a combination of sales / post sales, sales training, and enablement roles

• 5+ years of management experience leading and developing enablement teams

• Proven track record of building and delivering innovative, strategic sales enablement programs, including training, onboarding, certifications, and sales events

• Experience implementing and maintaining content management platforms such as Highspot or Seismic

• 3+ years of experience in high-velocity, high-growth startup environments, preferably in the SaaS space, or equivalent degree or experience

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong understanding of sales methodologies such as Force Management, MEDDIC and forecasting best practices

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively train and influence sales professionals at all levels

• Experience with Sales Operations and Salesforce.com

• Proficiency in using sales enablement tools, CRM systems, and content management platforms. Preferred platforms include Salesforce, Seismic, CRM Analytics, and more

• Analytical mindset with the ability to provide actionable insights

• Knowledge of Sales Manager training and sales coaching, particularly for Enterprise sales

• Strong program and project management skills with the ability to maintain calendars of ongoing training, business reviews, and field communications

• Detail and results-oriented with the ability to balance strategic planning and hands-on execution

• Collaborative and team-oriented approach with the ability to work cross-functionally

• Self-motivated and results-driven with a passion for driving sales excellence

• Excel in creating and curating sales collateral, playbooks, training modules, and other resources to support the sales team

• Have a track record of driving sales enablement initiatives across different regions and markets, understanding cultural nuances and local sales practices

 The base salary range for this position is 180,000 - 303,600 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.

 Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.

• You are equally comfortable white-boarding a complex micro services architecture with a Lead Architect as you are presenting a business value case to a Board of Directors.

• You don’t just want to close deals; you want to ensure customers achieve their desired outcomes and see PagerDuty as a mission-critical partner.

title: Engineering Manager, Cloud Engineering
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

 About the Job:

 We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead LaunchDarkly’s Cloud Engineering team, the team responsible for the foundational infrastructure our products and engineering teams depend on.

 Cloud Engineering owns LaunchDarkly’s AWS accounts and networking, multi-region Kubernetes infrastructure, Terraform and GitOps workflows, CockroachDB operations, disaster-recovery capabilities, and FedRAMP infrastructure posture. The team is small, senior, and recently rebuilt. This is a frontline leadership role for a manager who treats operational health as a top priority, leads calmly through incidents, and creates leverage through software, automation, and reliable paved paths.

 In your first year, you’ll lead a marquee infrastructure insourcing program from planning through completion. The program’s cost savings will help fund additional team growth, giving you the opportunity to deliver meaningful business impact while strengthening the infrastructure behind LaunchDarkly’s next stage of scale.

 This role combines people leadership, operational ownership, and technical judgment. You do not need to be the most senior individual contributor in the room, but you should be comfortable partnering with experienced engineers, guiding tradeoffs, and creating an environment where the team can do its best work.

 Responsibilities:

• Lead and develop a senior Cloud Engineering team, providing clear expectations, coaching, feedback, performance management, and career-development support.

• Own the operational health of LaunchDarkly’s cloud infrastructure, including incident response, on-call health, service-level objectives, resilience, and disaster recovery.

• Launch and deliver a multi-quarter infrastructure insourcing program, including sequencing work, managing dependencies, communicating milestones, and ensuring a successful transition.

• Guide technical priorities and tradeoffs across AWS infrastructure, networking, multi-region Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, datastore operations, and compliance-related infrastructure.

• Build leverage through software, automation, and paved paths that help product engineering teams use infrastructure safely and independently.

• Support migrations by providing guidance, patterns, and enablement while maintaining clear ownership boundaries with partner teams.

• Establish team norms for effective AI-assisted engineering and identify opportunities to reduce operational toil through AI and automation.

• Maintain team health and continuity through change, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and accountable environment.

• Partner with Service Frameworks, Core Platform, Revenue Platform, Data Platform, and product engineering teams on shared infrastructure priorities and cross-team dependencies.

• Communicate roadmaps, operational risks, investment needs, and progress clearly to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Participate in hiring and team planning as the organization grows.

 Qualifications:

• 2+ years of experience managing an infrastructure, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering team at a product company, including people management of an on-call team.

• Demonstrated ownership of incident response, on-call health, and service-level objective frameworks for critical production systems.

• Experience leading at least one multi-quarter infrastructure migration or insourcing program from planning through completion.

• Technical fluency with AWS, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code practices, with the judgment to guide discussions and tradeoffs with senior engineers.

• Experience taking over an established team and maintaining engagement, performance, and retention through a leadership transition.

• A clear point of view on team norms and practices for AI-assisted engineering.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and operational priorities to a range of audiences.

• A thoughtful, calm, and accountable leadership approach, particularly during incidents and periods of change.

 Nice to Haves

• Experience with vendor negotiations or cloud cost management.

• Experience supporting FedRAMP or other compliance-related infrastructure and operations.

• Experience operating large-scale datastores or OLAP systems.

• Experience growing a team through funded expansion.

 Pay:

 Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level M2:

• Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $191,800 - $263,670**

• Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $172,600 - $237,270**

• Zone 3: All other US locations - $163,000 - $224,070**

 About the Role

Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month.

 As an Senior Infrastructure Engineer you will:

• Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP.

• Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on.

• Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments.

• Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate, improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy.

• Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation.

• Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence.

 About you

 You’ll thrive as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer if you:

• Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.

• Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime.

• Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like.

• Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle.

• Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP.

• Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

• Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling.

• Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance.

• Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing.

Our Culture

Quantum Metric's number one objective is happy people, diverse and inclusive culture. We’re passionate about empowering our people to become the best version of themselves, offering coaching and training programs designed to accelerate their career in whatever direction they choose.

As a remote-first company, we understand the importance of building an engaged, diverse, and fun place to work. We are also passionate about the connections we build with our customers. You’ll not only work with some of the world’s most recognized brands, but build lasting relationships.

At Quantum Metric we value all types of experience and education and don’t expect you to meet every qualification for this position. We are most interested in the unique perspective you can bring and your ability to uphold our values of passion, persistence, and integrity.

As an Enterprise Solutions Engineer (EMEA) at Quantum Metric, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor supporting complex, high-value sales opportunities across the region. Working in close partnership with Enterprise Account Executives, you will engage with large, multinational organizations to help them transform how they understand and optimize digital customer experiences.

In this role, you will guide the technical strategy for enterprise deals, aligning Quantum Metric’s platform with strategic business initiatives. You will connect with diverse audiences—from digital and product teams to C-level executives—positioning Quantum Metric as a critical component of enterprise digital transformation.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with Account Executives on deal orchestration and coordinate with Product/Engineering to ensure smooth post-sales onboarding.

  • Market Influence: Support RFP responses and provide structured customer feedback to influence the product roadmap.

Requirements

  • Linguistic Skills: Proficiency in English and German; additional European languages preferred.

  • Experience: 4+ years in Enterprise Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering within the SaaS or software sector.

  • Sales Acumen: Proven success supporting complex, multi-layered sales cycles for large enterprise organizations.

  • Technical Depth: Hands-on experience with web technologies (JavaScript, HTML, CSS) and ROI-based solutioning.

  • Communication: Exceptional storytelling and presentation skills tailored for diverse corporate environments.

  • Agility: Strong organizational skills to manage multiple strategic deals and a willingness to travel 25–30% across EMEA.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Digital Experience Analytics or CXM platforms.

  • Familiarity with agentic AI, enterprise data architecture, or tagging strategies.

  • Background in high-growth SaaS or digital transformation consulting.

70,000 - 95,000 GBP basic + variable

As a leader in digital analytics, Quantum Metric helps organizations put customers at the heart of everything they do. title: Software Engineer in Network Infrastructure
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to build software that makes network operations safe, scalable, and boring — even as we launch new data centers and expand fast. This is not a “write scripts for configs” role: you’ll build the tooling and services that sit between the network core (switches/ports/VLANs, traffic processors) and the cloud platform on top, using open source where it fits and building the missing pieces where it doesn’t.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build and maintain services and tooling that automate the network lifecycle: day-0 provisioning, day-N changes, drift detection, and operational verification
  • Make network changes safe and transparent: CI/CD workflows, diff/review tooling, staged rollouts/rollbacks, audit trails, and guardrails
  • Develop observability systems that scale across many sites: telemetry pipelines, signal quality, and tooling that shortens incident investigations
  • Close “last mile” gaps between the network and the platform: integrate source-of-truth data, expose APIs, and build reliable automation around it
  • Collaborate closely with network engineers and SREs to turn real operational pain into product-quality tooling

We expect you to have:

The Role

We’re looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to help build and run the fundamental part of Nebius - the Network - the infrastructure everything else depends on. This is an engineering-first SRE role: you’ll set clear reliability targets, build the tooling and automation to meet them, and make the network safer to operate as we scale quickly.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Define and own reliability goals for network services and critical paths (SLIs/SLOs, availability targets, error budgets where it makes sense)
  • Drive reliability improvements across the whole network: not only services, but also site readiness, inter-site connectivity (DCI), and operational standards
  • Own incident response for your areas, lead investigations/postmortems, and turn failures into durable fixes (not repeated firefighting)
  • Build and evolve observability: actionable metrics/logs/traces, alerting, and faster debug loops during and after incidents

It will be an added bonus if you have:

description:
PLACEMENT STUDENT - Supply Chain Logistics, Darlington

We are looking for an enthusiastic Supply Chain Logistics Placement Student to join our team specializing in Logistics for our Corporate/CBS Segment in Darlington, UK. During your placement with us, you will learn how a major global organization operates, gaining the tools and exposure you will need to become an expert in the industry.

This role is available to candidates who qualify for a placement year and will commence Summer of 2027.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Support day-to-day transportation and logistics operations for inbound and outbound shipments; assist with the planning, booking, tracking, and monitoring of road, air, ocean, and courier shipments.
  • Liaise with carriers, freight forwarders, warehouses, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to resolve transportation issues and support service delivery; monitor shipment progress and proactively communicate risks, delays, and recovery actions.
  • Support the preparation and validation of shipping documentation, customs documentation, commercial invoices, and transportation paperwork; assist with transportation planning during peak demand periods, plant shutdowns, and operational constraints.

  • Develop KPI reporting and logistics dashboards to improve operational visibility and decision-making; work collaboratively with Planning, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Customer Support, Shipping, Warehousing, and Trade Compliance teams to support uninterrupted supply chain operations.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Studying towards a degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, Economics, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Strong interest in transportation, logistics, and global supply chain operations; excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment along with the ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a team.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities; great communication skills and confidence working with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, Access, or similar analytical tools would be beneficial but is not essential.

title: Product Lead, Predictive Platform
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

 Our Mission:

 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

 Our People:

 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

 Product Lead, Predictive Platform

 Are you a strategic thinker with a deep background in predictive modeling and a passion for leading teams? At 6sense, our differentiation is built on our ability to accurately predict intent and buyer behavior. We are looking for a Product Lead to own our Predictive Platform—the foundational engine that powers our entire intelligence layer and defines how the world's leading B2B brands identify their next customers.

 This is a Player/Coach role. You will be the primary driver of our core predictive foundation and cross-model initiatives while simultaneously serving as the people manager and program leader for a specialized pod of Product Managers. You will oversee the roadmap for how we train, measure, and scale the models that power everything from Fit and Intent to Engagement and Triage.

 Why 6sense?

• AI That Builds Pipe, Not Hype: Our Revenue AI™ identifies accounts ready to buy, crafts the right message, and qualifies meetings automatically. We don’t just surface data—we deliver intelligence and action.

• Crack the Dark Funnel™: Less than 3% of buyers engage early. We uncover hidden buying signals, decode the “breadcrumb trails,” and help revenue teams connect with buyers in ways they never could before.

• Orchestrate the Full Journey: From dynamic audience creation to multi-channel engagement, we empower marketers to reach the right accounts, at the right time, with the right message—across advertising, email, web, and sales.

• Arm Operations Teams: Integrate insights, centralize audience creation, and maximize impact by connecting 6sense with your tech stack. We’re the single canvas for your entire GTM strategy.

 Your Impact

 As Product Lead, Predictive Platform, you will:

• Lead and Scale a Specialized Pod. Act as a formal people manager for a pod of Product Managers focused on specialized modeling and intelligence initiatives. You will be responsible for their growth, performance, and alignment with the broader intelligence strategy.

• Own the Core Predictive Foundation. Personally drive the strategy for our core models. You will define the roadmap for how these models are consumed by downstream applications across the entire 6sense ecosystem.

• Drive Cross-Model Initiatives. Establish the global standards and methodologies for ongoing model training, feedback loops, and accuracy measurement to ensure our predictions remain the industry benchmark.

• Maximize Model Leverage. Enforce a "build once, use everywhere" philosophy, ensuring that platform engines provide maximum value to all surface apps and specialized use cases.

• Be a Strategic Partner to Leadership. Partner directly with the Head of Intelligence Product to align the predictive roadmap with company strategy, surfacing model risks early and identifying opportunities for portfolio tradeoffs.

 Strategic Themes You'll Drive

• Customer Trust and Reliability. Drive the strategy for building high-integrity intelligence that is trusted by enterprise leaders and adapts to a wide range of global business requirements.

• Leveraged Engine Strategy. Move toward an operating model where core predictive engines are seamlessly consumed by all App teams, reducing duplication and accelerating time-to-market.

• Data-to-Model Integrity. Ensure the connective tissue between our data foundation and our predictive layer is robust and high performing.

 What You'll Bring

• People Leadership. Proven experience building and leading product teams. You know how to coach PMs through complex roadmaps and create a culture of high accountability.

• Predictive Product Mastery. Deep expertise in predictive modeling, machine learning lifecycles, and data science collaboration from a product perspective. You have a track record of shipping complex ML-driven products at scale.

• Operating Rigor. You build operating rhythms that turn messy data and model dependencies into clean execution. You focus on the methodologies that ensure long-term product performance.

• B2B Mindset. Strong understanding of B2B data models and how predictive scoring drives GTM outcomes.

• Experience. 8-10+ years in Product Management, with a focus on AI, ML, or Data Science products, including 3-5+ years of formal people management experience.

 Why You’ll Love This Role

• Impact: Your work creates the Predictive Core for the entire company, ensuring our foundational modeling engines remain the most accurate and trusted in the B2B market.

• Innovation: You will define the Predictive Lifecycle Strategy , building the architectural leverage that allows our modeling teams to move from discovery to platform-wide deployment with high velocity.

• Growth: Join a rocket ship, learn every day, and accelerate your career in a collaborative, high-energy environment.

• Fun: We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. Expect GIFs, puns, and the occasional ABM meme.

description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world's digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You'll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You'll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you-because when you feel valued, you're empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

The Strategic Client Executive / Global Account Manager is responsible for owning the commercial success, growth, and long-term platform expansion of one or more of Equinix's most strategic global customers within a global account framework.

This role operates in a highly complex, matrixed environment with sophisticated customers, advanced procurement organizations, legacy contracts, and multi-year architectural and commercial dependencies.

The Strategic Client Executive provides end-to-end commercial leadership across the account lifecycle-driving demand, shaping customer architecture decisions, protecting revenue, and ensuring a consistent, high-quality global customer experience.

The role serves as the single point of accountability for sustained, profitable growth, revenue protection, executive engagement, and disciplined execution, while leading a virtual, cross-functional account team across regions and functions.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account Ownership & Growth

  • Own sustained, profitable growth for assigned strategic accounts, proactively shaping demand
  • Translate customer business priorities and technology direction into a documented multi-year vision and growth roadmap, used as the internal operating plan
  • Balance long-term platform positioning with near-term business, exercising sound judgment on opportunity prioritization, pursuit, delay, or de-commitment
  • Source and co-create opportunities within the region in close alignment with global account leadership
  • Build a predictable run rate whilst developing large strategic initiatives
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management, forecast accuracy, and CRM rigor

Architecture & Platform Leadership

  • Lead future-state infrastructure and platform discussions with customers, confirming Equinix as a long-term digital infrastructure and interconnection partner,
  • Influence customer architecture decisions across colocation, interconnection, and built to suit data centers to drive durable platform expansion
  • Anchor commercial discussions in customer outcomes, business value, and long-term architectural direction
  • Ensure interconnection is positioned as a strategic enabler in all relevant strategic account conversations

Revenue Protection, Renewals & Account Health

  • Own the full commercial lifecycle of the account, treating growth and retention with equal rigor
  • Anticipate any risk to revenue retention early and lead proactive, coordinated renewal strategies
  • Align closely with CRO partners including Customer Success, Sales, and Operational teams to protect long-term account health and prevent churn
  • Lead timely contract negotiations and ensure alignment to RFS and billing milestones

 We are looking for a Product Manager to own the Vercel Dashboard, the control plane for every Vercel user, defining how developers and teams interact with Vercel from first login through daily use, across both individual accounts and enterprise organizations. title: Design Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

 About Vercel:

 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

 Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

 About the Role:

 AI Gateway gives developers one place to connect applications and agents to hundreds of models with one API key. It handles provider routing and fallbacks, unifies billing and observability, and lets teams manage spend and security controls across production AI workloads.

 Designing this well is a systems problem. A developer should be able to choose the right model, make and verify a first request, diagnose a failed request, and configure routing, budgets, credentials, and security controls without losing sight of the application they are trying to build. The right interface might be in the dashboard, on the public model catalog, in the CLI, in an API response, or in code.

 You will be the Design Engineer for AI Gateway, owning product design and frontend implementation across those surfaces. You will work with customers, a Product Manager, and engineers to understand the problem, explore solutions, build the production experience, ship it, and learn from what happens after launch.

 AI Gateway is live, the model ecosystem changes every week, and the team can move from an observed problem to production quickly. This is a rare chance to use your product judgment, design craft, and code to shape a developer product and ship the experience yourself.

 You will be the design owner embedded with a Product Manager and a dedicated engineering team. You will also have the Product Design team around you for critique, collaboration, and support. AI Gateway will be your main product area, with room to pursue design-led improvements across Vercel. You will report to the Design Team.

 If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

 What You Will Do:

• Own product design and frontend implementation for meaningful parts of the journey from discovering a model to making a first successful request and operating AI in production.

• Design and build production experiences across the website, dashboard, CLI, and APIs, choosing the right medium for each problem.

• Make models, providers, credentials, routing, budgets, logs, performance, privacy, and governance understandable, then create patterns that extend across new providers, modalities, and workloads.

• Talk directly with customers and use product data to understand problems, define success, make tradeoffs, and improve what ships.

• Own quality after launch, including visual and interaction craft, accessibility, performance, resilience, instrumentation, and edge cases.

• Use coding agents to explore and implement ideas quickly, while testing, debugging, and taking responsibility for what ships.

 About You:

• Your work shows what you personally identified, designed, built, shipped, and learned after launch.

• You build production-quality web applications with React and TypeScript and can contribute confidently in a large, existing codebase.

• You bring strong visual and interaction craft and have made technical or data-rich products understandable without removing the control advanced users need.

• You can move between graphical interfaces, CLI workflows, API behavior, and implementation details, treating accessibility, performance, failure recovery, and instrumentation as part of the design.

• You use customer research and product data to make decisions, communicate your reasoning clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and change direction when the evidence changes.

• You use coding agents in your daily work, but you can explain, test, debug, and take responsibility for the code they help produce.

 There is no required path into this role. You may come from product design, frontend engineering, creative development, or a career that does not fit a standard title. We care about the quality of what you have shipped and the judgment behind it.

 Bonus If You:

• Have experience with developer tools, infrastructure products, model marketplaces, or observability experiences.

• Have experience with APIs, command-line tools, structured product content, or agent-facing interfaces.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

 About Calm

Calm is the leading mental health brand on a mission to make the world happier and healthier. Known for its flagship consumer app—ranked #1 in its category with over 180 million downloads and availability in ten languages across 190 countries—Calm helps people sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully through content and tools from experts and beloved celebrity voices. Building on this foundation, Calm has created a broader portfolio including evidence-based solutions like Calm Health , offered through employers, health plans and providers, designed to expand access to mental health and sleep support, boost benefits engagement, and drive positive health outcomes. Today, Calm supports more than 3,500 organizations and reaches over 42 million covered lives through Calm Health. Calm has been recognized as a TIME100 Most Influential Company and one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter . Learn more at calm.com .

 What We Do

 At Calm we believe in making relaxation, better sleep, and mindfulness accessible to the entire world, and we hope you will help us achieve our mission. The Product & Design team is responsible for delivering Calm to our customers, ensuring that it is easy to use, supports their goals, and maintains a high level of quality across web, iOS, Android platforms.

 As a Senior Product Designer on our Consumer team, you'll shape experiences used by tens of millions of people to sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully. People often reach for Calm in their most vulnerable moments, so the craft of what we make (how it looks, moves, and feels) matters enormously.

 This is a builder's role in the truest sense: you'll use AI and modern prototyping tools to move from insight to interactive prototype to shipped experience, not as a shortcut on quality, but to spend less time producing and more time on the judgment and detail that make an experience great. When anyone can generate a hundred screens in an afternoon, taste and judgment are the differentiators!

 The heart of this role is balancing velocity and craft in service of making our users healthier and happier, and building intuitive, engaging and impactful experiences that drive acquisition, engagement and retention. You'll partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing, and set the standard for craft across iOS, Android, and web. You will be a thought leader in design, helping to establish best practices and setting the bar for exceptional product design at Calm.

 What You’ll Do

• Own end-to-end product design initiatives that cover the whole product experience (visual, interaction, motion, brand integration), to create thoughtful, high-quality user-centered mobile experiences.

• Prototype quickly in Figma and with AI and low-code tools like Replit, Lovable, and Claude, so you can get real, testable ideas in front of people early.

• Present your design work clearly and persuasively to cross-functional stakeholders (including senior leadership), give and take feedback well, anchoring your rationale to both user needs and business goals.

• Maintain strong attention to detail and collaboration through engineering implementation (build and QA) and post launch-iterations, to ensure high-quality execution.

• Use data and drive research to inform the experiences you build, and leverage performance insights to evolve your approach.

• Champion system-level thinking (improving how the team works and evolving Calm's design system) so the whole team works faster and smarter.

• Balance multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of execution.

 Who You Are

• Experienced Product Designer: 7+ years of experience in UX and UI design with 5+ within consumer mobile and web applications.

• AI-native and tooling-fluent: Highly proficient in Figma for design, and already using AI and low-code tools (Replit, Lovable, Claude) to prototype and move fast, with the judgment to know when the output is good enough and when it isn't.

• Technical agility: Comfortable shipping small code changes without engineering support, bridging the gap between design and engineering by personally shipping copy and UI polish directly.

• A builder: Biased toward shipping and iterating over perfect plans. You'd rather put a working prototype in front of people than write a doc about one.

• Data- and research-informed: You fold both qualitative and quantitative insight into your design decisions, and you measure whether the work landed.

• A strong collaborator: A low-ego, trusted partner to Product, Research, and Engineering who makes the people around them better and helps sharpen how the team works.

• High craft standards: A strong advocate for accessibility, consistency, visual storytelling, brand integration, and motion design to create engaging user experiences, while still maintaining velocity.

• A clear communicator: You present your thinking persuasively to stakeholders and senior leadership, give and take feedback well, and champion an experience while staying open to being wrong.

 Nice to Haves

• Experience with conversational or AI-native UX.

• Experience working at multiple organizations, ideally including time at a consumer product in a fast-paced startup environment.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to design and ship beautiful, functional, and user-friendly experiences.

• Comfort shipping small copy and UI changes directly in code, without engineering support.

• A passion for Calm's mission and a point of view on how digital products can support mental health.

 Minimum Requirements

• 7+ years in UX/UI design with 5+ within consumer mobile (and web) applications.

• Proven experience driving user testing and research.

• Strong foundation in interaction design, visual design, and usability best practices.

• Experience designing and shipping mobile applications at scale.

• Hands-on proficiency in Figma and modern AI/prototyping tools.

• Ability to work independently while contributing to a larger design vision and strategy.

title: Growth Product Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

 About Calm

Calm is the leading mental health brand on a mission to make the world happier and healthier. Known for its flagship consumer app—ranked #1 in its category with over 180 million downloads and availability in ten languages across 190 countries—Calm helps people sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully through content and tools from experts and beloved celebrity voices. Building on this foundation, Calm has created a broader portfolio including evidence-based solutions like Calm Health , offered through employers, health plans and providers, designed to expand access to mental health and sleep support, boost benefits engagement, and drive positive health outcomes. Today, Calm supports more than 3,500 organizations and reaches over 42 million covered lives through Calm Health. Calm has been recognized as a TIME100 Most Influential Company and one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter . Learn more at calm.com .

 What You'll Do

 As a Growth Product Manager on Calm's direct-to-consumer business, you'll help more people discover, adopt, and build daily habits with Calm. You'll own the growth product strategy and roadmap, accountable for driving subscriber growth, activation, revenue per user, and retention. You'll set the priorities, design and run the experiments that test them, and partner with engineering, product design, marketing, data, and research to ship what works. Your goal is to make it effortless for users to form a lasting mindfulness habit while helping Calm reach and sustain its growth goals.

 As a Product Manager working on Calm’s direct-to-consumer business, you will drive measurable impact across top-of-funnel conversion, trial-to-paid transitions, user activation, and long-term retention. You will design, execute, and analyze product experiments in collaboration with engineering, design, marketing, and data science teams.

 Day to day, you will:

• Own growth strategy and roadmap: Develop and own Calm's growth product strategy and roadmap, translating company revenue, subscriber, and DAU goals into a prioritized set of bets across activation, conversion, and retention.

• Run a high-velocity experiment program: Form sharp hypotheses, design and ship A/B tests with engineering and data science, and read results honestly — including the ones that don't win.

• Remove friction from key journeys: Use quantitative and qualitative data to find where users drop off in onboarding, habit-building, and account flows, then test simpler paths through them.

• Ship habit mechanics: Build the features that help users plan, track, and celebrate progress, so a first session becomes a daily practice.

• Write PRDs that make decisions easy : Spell out the job to be done, the opportunity, success metrics, and the plan to ship and iterate — then bring engineers, designers, marketers, and leadership along as the plan changes.

 Who You Are

• A growth PM, or equivalent, who's owned the number: 4+ years in consumer product, with a track record of owning a growth metric (subscriber growth, conversion, retention) and setting the strategy to move it, across consumer mobile (iOS and Android) and web.

• A subscription-business operator: Fluent in the economics of consumer subscription (trial and paywall conversion, LTV, churn) and how product decisions show up in them.

• A rapid experimenter: Experienced in fast experiment design and analysis (A/B tests, holdouts, sequential testing), with the statistical judgment to know when a result is real and when it's noise.

• Data-fluent: Adept at sourcing quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize a roadmap and make feature calls, and decisive when the data won't settle it.

• A student of habit formation: You know what drives repeat daily usage and how to build the mechanics (streaks, reminders, progress, celebration) that turn a new user into a daily one.

• AI-native and tooling-fluent: Highly proficient in leveraging AI tools to drive team velocity and build lasting workflows, with the judgment to know when the output is good enough and when it isn't.

• Technically agile: Comfortable discussing complexity and tradeoffs with engineers, and able to prototype your own ideas rather than wait in a queue.

• Exceptional at documentation and organization: You keep the experiment log, results archive, and roadmap docs in a state where anyone can find what was tested, what it showed, and what's live (so the team builds on its own learnings instead of rediscovering them.)

• A low-ego, persuasive partner: You present your thinking clearly in writing and in the room, to stakeholders and senior leadership alike, hold positions with conviction and update them on evidence, and make Product Design, User Acquisition, Research, and Engineering better for working with you.

 Nice to Haves

• Experience in subscription-based consumer tech (onboarding, paywalls, or retention initiatives).

• Familiarity with product analytics or experimentation tools (e.g., Amplitude).

• Experience working with or passion for the health & wellness domain.

• Experience in developing features that drive habit formation and lifestyle change.

 Minimum Requirements

• 4+ years of relevant experience in growth, product management, or equivalent.

title: Software Engineer - Developer Experience
description:
Headquarters: Portugal - Remote

 Be Part of Building the Future

 Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost. Learn more at www.dremio.com.

 About the role

 In this role you will get opportunities to implement and maintain CI/CD systems and developer productivity solutions. You will be responsible for both regularly scheduled work as well as on-demand break-fix work to support Dremio’s CI/CD system, identifying areas of improvement, and implementing changes to increase efficiency and effectiveness of those systems.

 Bring your industry experience to improve the efficiency and scale of Dremio’s infrastructure via innovation on tooling and methodologies. You should have empathy for developers and a passion for engineering productivity.

 What you’ll be doing

• Solve problems for fellow Dremio engineers by:

• Leveraging and contributing to playbooks to implement solutions to unblock them

• Identifying short term workarounds and documenting them

• Automating processes where manual processes exist.

• Working on infrastructure across all major clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure).

• Managing access to key infrastructure.

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and associated systems to increase organizational efficiency.

• Automate local development workflows.

• Analyze performance bottlenecks, root cause issues, file defects, follow up with developers, and document resolutions.

• Clear focus on keeping our development branches ‘green’.

• Release engineering - automating processes to push software to delivery endpoints.

• Report out on the status, reliability and robustness of our CI/CD systems.

• Actively participate in code reviews.

 What we’re looking for

• B.S. or M.S in Computer Science or in a related technical field

• 1+ years of experience on large scale distributed systems

• Comfortable navigating the fast moving, unstructured nature of a hyper-growth startup.

• Demonstrable Knowledge and Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP)

• Basic understanding of cloud networking and cloud architecture.

• Proficiency in any of Java/C++/Python/Go

• Knowledge of Maven or similar build environments

• Hands on experience in pipeline automation using CI/CD tools like Jenkins

• Experience in Infrastructure as Code

• Experience with Terraform, BASH, Docker, Jenkins, and Kubernetes

• Ability to write technical reports, effectively summarizing key data

• Passion for learning and then delivering solutions using latest technologies

• Strong Affinity for collaboration and teamwork

 Bonus points if you have

• Working knowledge in data lakes and data warehousing

• Proficient with SQL

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Query Execution
description:
Headquarters: Portugal - Remote

 Be Part of Building the Future

 Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost. Learn more at www.dremio.com.

 About the role

 Dremio’s Query Execution team builds the runtime responsible for executing analytical queries at scale. The team sits between query planning and table scans, owning the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution.

 As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you’ll work on query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and performance optimization. Your work will directly affect query performance, scalability, and reliability across Dremio’s cloud data platform.

 What you’ll be doing

• Build the execution engine: Design, implement, test, and support query operators, expression evaluation, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and resource management.

• Improve runtime performance: Optimize vectorized processing, concurrency, parallelism, memory usage, data exchange, and disk spilling.

• Diagnose difficult problems: Investigate query correctness and performance issues using query profiles, profiling tools, telemetry, benchmarks, logs, and production data.

• Optimize Java and the JVM: Improve CPU utilization, allocation behavior, garbage collection, thread behavior, and other runtime characteristics.

• Collaborate across the query engine: Work with Query Planner, Datalake, Product, Support, and field engineering teams on end-to-end query improvements.

• Use AI-assisted development tools: Apply AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, documentation, and incident analysis.

• Apply engineering judgment: Validate AI-generated code and recommendations through review, testing, benchmarking, and engineering judgment.

• Raise the engineering bar: Participate in design and code reviews, contribute to technical direction, and mentor other engineers.

 What we’re looking for

• Software engineering experience: 5+ years developing production software, preferably in database systems, query execution, distributed systems, or related areas.

• Programming skills: Strong Java skills; experience with C++ is a plus.

• Computer science fundamentals: Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, multithreaded programming, and asynchronous programming.

• Database and distributed systems knowledge: Understanding of database internals, query processing, distributed execution, and performance optimization.

• Performance engineering experience: Experience profiling and optimizing CPU, memory, garbage collection, thread behavior, or other runtime characteristics.

• Problem-solving ability: Ability to solve ambiguous technical problems and work effectively across team boundaries.

• Engineering judgment: Ability to evaluate tradeoffs, validate solutions rigorously, and make sound decisions when working with unfamiliar or AI-assisted implementations.

• Communication and ownership: Strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality software.

 Bonus points if you have

• Query engines: Distributed query engines, database engines, or large-scale data processing systems.

• Execution techniques: Vectorized execution, query operators, expression evaluation, code generation, or runtime optimization.

• Runtime systems: JVM profiling, memory management, caching, networking, data exchange, execution scheduling, or disk spilling.

• Data platforms: Apache Arrow, Apache Iceberg, Parquet, Avro, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud object stores.

• Open source: Contributing to open-source projects.

title: Director, Global Equity
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

 About Faire

 Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

 About this role

 Faire is revolutionizing wholesale and helping local retailers and their suppliers succeed in a technology-enabled era. As a Director, Global Equity, you will own and continue to evolve Faire’s global equity programs, building on an existing foundation while enhancing the structure, rigor, and scalability required to support public company readiness. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, brings strong judgment, and wants to shape how equity operates with true end-to-end ownership.

 As a Director, Global Equity You Will

• Own and scale Faire’s global equity programs end-to-end, spanning plan design, administration, accounting, compliance, and employee experience across all equity award types and jurisdictions.

• Serve as the senior owner of equity operations, partnering with Finance, Accounting, Payroll, Legal, and People to build durable, audit-ready processes that scale with company growth.

• Lead public company equity responsibilities, including SEC reporting support, insider trading programs, audit readiness, and the design and operation of equity-related internal controls.

• Oversee the full equity lifecycle, including grant issuance, vesting, exercises, releases, share pool management, and reconciliations between the equity platform and general ledger.

• Design, implement, and optimize equity systems and workflows, including Shareworks (or equivalent) integrations with payroll, HRIS, and financial reporting systems.

• Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for complex employee, executive, and stakeholder equity matters, exercising sound judgment and discretion.

• Proactively manage global regulatory, tax, and compliance risk, partnering with Legal and external advisors to ensure equity programs remain compliant as Faire scales internationally.

 Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, Law or equivalent practical experience

• 10+ years of experience in stock plan administration, including leadership in complex or high-growth environments

• CEP certification strongly preferred

• Deep expertise in global equity programs, with hands-on knowledge of legal, tax, and payroll considerations across multiple jurisdictions.

• Experience with designing and implementing an Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Proven experience scaling equity programs through private-to-public readiness or public company operations.

• Advanced analytical and systems skills; Shareworks (or equivalent) expertise required.

• Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functionally without authority, including working with senior leaders.

• You are resourceful and not afraid to roll up your sleeves.

 Salary Range

 California & New York: the pay range for this role is $184,000 to $253,000 per year.

 Zone B : the pay range for this role is $165,500 to $227,500 per year.

 Zone C : the pay range for this role is $147,000 to $202,500 per year.

 Note: This is a remote role open to candidates located in Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, or Wisconsin

 This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.
 Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.

 Why you’ll love working at Faire

• Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.

• Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.

• Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.

• Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.

• Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.

 Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog .

 Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.

 Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs. To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our Accommodation Request Form ( https://bit.ly/faire-form)

At Soho House, a Runner plays a vital supporting role in ensuring the smooth and efficient flow of service between the kitchen and front-of-house teams. As a key link in the dining experience, the Runner is responsible for delivering food and beverages promptly, maintaining cleanliness and organisation across the service areas.  .  

Your main responsibility is to assist the waiting staff and make sure the member gets a superior experience. You will deliver food orders from the kitchen (or drinks orders from the bar) to members’ tables, acting as a point of contact between the kitchen/bar and the floor.

  • Team meal whilst on shift prepared by our chefs
  • Soho Friends Membership
  • 50% Team discount on Food & Drink, 7 days a week
  • Staff Room Rates
